semiconductor_relevance: High — Primarius Technologies specializes in electronic design automation (EDA) solutions that are critical for semiconductor design and manufacturing processes.
summary: Primarius Technologies Co., Ltd. is a global leader in EDA, providing advanced design enablement technologies for SPICE modeling, PDK generation, and standard cell library characterizations. Their innovative Design Technology Co-Optimization (DTCO) solutions aim to accelerate time-to-market and enhance yield per unit area (YPPA) for complex memory, analog, and mixed-signal designs.
capabilities: Custom design EDA flow for complex designs
